Thank the Force. We've located your crash site, but it looks like the Empire will reach you first. Prepare to defend yourselves until we can get there!|Admiral Gial Ackbar|}} The '''Skirmish on Tatooine''' was a skirmish between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]] that occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War]] in and around the [[Beggar's Canyon]] [[Raider Camp]]. ==Battle== {{Quote|Ugh! Not my best landing.''"
"''Hey, let's go!|Two rebel soldiers|}} After escaping an Imperial attack, two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] soldiers landed on [[Tatooine]] via [[escape pod]]s near a [[Tusken Raider]] camp. The [[Galactic Empire]] then dispatched AT-STs, [[stormtrooper]]s, [[scout trooper]]s, [[shadow trooper]]s, [[Rocket stormtrooper|Demolition Troopers]], and [[Imperial shock trooper]]s to engage them, while [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] arrived in an [[MC80 Star Cruiser]] and engaged the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Great work! We've driven back the Empire! We're coming to pick you up!|Admiral Ackbar|}} Eventually, Imperial ground forces were defeated, and a group of [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s flew down and proceeded to attack the fleeing stormtroopers, while the [[Star Destroyer]] crashed down onto the planet. ==Behind the scenes== Part of the Skirmish on Tatooine was one of the Survival Missions for ''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]'' {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Tatooine (Galactic Civil War), skirmish on}} [[Category:Battles of Tatooine]] [[Category:Battles of the Galactic Civil War]]
